sourceInstructions: <root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">AI-generated fictional demo instructions. Not validated engineering or safety instructions. ML Bottom Bracket. Fictional subassembly demonstration for model 96, ML Bottom Bracket, representative product BB-8107 (995). The draft covers inventory, inspection, and a conditional fitting demonstration; the supplied BOM does not establish the mating arrangement.<Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="1.0" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Subassembly: inventory and inspect the representative product's direct BOM components, then demonstrate fitting only if their arrangement is confirmed.<step>Set out 10 EA of <material>BB Ball Bearing (Product Number BE-2349)</material> and 1 EA of <material>HL Shell (Product Number SH-9312)</material>. Use inventory view <diag>100961</diag> to check the direct BOM quantities.</step><step>Visually inspect the components for obvious damage or contamination and set aside any questionable items.</step><step>If the mating arrangement has been independently confirmed, use <tool>an assumed hand-held assembly jig</tool> to support a trial fit without forcing the components. Otherwise, hold the set for clarification.</step><step>After any confirmed trial fit, check for visible damage or interference; do not treat the demonstration as a release inspection.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: Work center 50 is inferred for this demonstration from a historical routing entry; that entry is evidence, not an engineering specification.
The BOM lists 10 EA of product 3 as bearing subassemblies, not 10 individual bearing balls. Its nested BOM lists 10 EA bearing balls per subassembly.
The catalog description mentions aluminum-alloy cups and a spindle, but the direct BOM does not identify them as separate components. Their identities and mating geometry must not be assumed.
Fitting is conditional on confirming the component arrangement from authoritative product information not supplied here.
variantNotes: Only product 995, BB-8107, is supplied as a variant; its color and size are unspecified.
No variant-specific component substitutions are supplied.
